en: You carry the taint of the Scourge.  Prepare to enter the Twisting Nether.
BURN! You wretches! BURN!
What... what is this? Could this be the answer to my prayers? Elune has granted me a weapon--this scythe--to defeat the demons.
The guards of Theramore are the finest group of Alliance soldiers based in Kalimdor. It is our duty to uphold the laws of the Alliance even so far away from our homes.
The toxin is ready, $n.
I am ready, Remulos.
Are you daft? Who else would I be talking about? Yes, the girl - Mistress Mar'alith. Anyhow, she was back and not in too good of a mood. That's when the demands started flowing.
You will pay for what you've done to Trey, $r!
I need a ride out of here, Martin.

Indeed. The Scarlet Crusade are an aberration of the Order of the Silver Hand.$B$BYou must believe me, $r; Taelan is a good man. He needs guidance. He needs to remember... remember what it is to be noble and honorable. I know that in his heart, he knows what he does is wrong. Will you help him? Will you help him remember?
Skaldrenox!  I hold your scepter, and charge you to enter this world!
Thanks for the cask of booze, $n.  I think I'll open up a bottle right now!
If we use the Surian theory, then yes, but not if we go with the Y'serian approach.

Now that the Stormpike general is defeated, we can spare a few troops to guard Winterax Hold.  But we must be ever vigilant, $c, for the Alliance will return.$B$BWhen you find them skulking about, teach them another lesson!
Here is some food for you Trok! Trok? Why are you running around like fearful human?
You're looking for Urtrun Clanbringer in the Horde Embassy.  Find it on the west side of the Valley of Strength.
%s spots a zombie to devour!
Elder Dawnstrider can be found at Flame Crest on the Burning Steppes.
I have outfitted kings. With the proper training, you can too.
Amazing to see little flowers persist in the cold of Dun Morogh...  but ye won't find any herbalists out here.  Ye'll have to go to Ironforge to get some training in that profession.
Those goblins should be ashamed of themselves.  Bah!
%s is nearly at full strength!
%s recoils in pain as the Judgement of Wisdom washes over it!

You'll need to head to Orgrimmar for that.  Just follow the road heading out of Razor Hill to the north through the canyon and you'll come to it.  When you get there ask one of their grunts for further directions.
Greetings, $c.  I pity your kind, for the secrets of true magic are beyond you...
I got your back, Slidore, but to be honest, you do stink. Take a shower, man.
There's an herbalist that lives in the hills east of Stormwind with our alchemist. Quite the handy pairing don't you think?
You will suffer in this defeat, Nefarian!
But if we stabilize it with an anchor thread at the appropriate energy crux then it should work.

"Darnassae?"$B$BThe night elf druid looks at you expectantly, but it is clear you cannot verbally communicate with her.  Undaunted, she points to herself and smiles.  She points at you and smiles once more.  She finally motions several times down the path to the north.$B$BPerhaps she is indicating that there is a druid you can speak to further up the road?
%s follows $n.
My colleagues and I are gathering the deadliest substances we know and testing their effects on our enemies. Once I have everything I need, I shall brew such plagues as this world has never seen.
Lucius is an old and trusted friend of Ravenholdt Manor - he and I have much to discuss. Find me at the docks in Lakeshire should you require my assistance or council.
Well my friend, you've reached heights some people only dream of. Congrats! And now, without further ceremony, it is time for your final lesson!
We have a lot of excess supplies, but we still need more before we can send an assualt into the Field of Strife.
The Scourge's plague still dominates the zone, and we have a long way to go before the plague will be altered enough to affect them.  Collect the necessary resources and help out the war effort!
Dark forces encroach upon our borders, ancient taints resurface, and new evils emerge to topple the delicate balance of the land. In times of such darkness, we all must be vigilant.
Ishnu-dal-dieb, $n. Have you come here in search of knowledge?
Tower Point holds the pass between the Field of Strife and the Horde territories to the south.$B$BIt is controlled by the Horde.

The skill with which Telonis crafts armor is beyond compare.  You should be grateful that he does not charge more for the knowledge he passes to others.  Go now and seek him out in the Craftsmen's Terrace in the northeast section of Darnassus.
Long live $n!
The battle for Warsong Gulch begins in 1 minute.
By Lothar, you Defias scum will pay!
Intruders at the Service Gate! Baron Rivendare must be warned!
The silithid are no match for the sons and daughters of Orgrimmar.  Soon all that will be left of them are their crushed limbs and wings under our feet, $n.
Little forsaken know all weapons.  Him Archibald.  You find on inner ring of War Quarter.
What the squawk??? Squawk squawk, squawk? SQUAWK!
